paite: Gentheite ngaihtuahmi ahampha hi, mangbat ni in TOUPA'N amah ahumbit ding.
heading: David La / Dam louh Hun A Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Blessed is he who considers the poor. Yahweh will deliver him in the day of evil.

paite: TOUPA'N amah humbit in ahihhing ding a, lei ah vualzawl in a-om ding; amah doute'n ut-ut a abawl ding un ape kei ding.
english: Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

paite: TOUPA'N agimna lupna mun ah ahihhat ding a; nang achi anat lai in alupna na bawlsak vek zel hi.
english: Yahweh will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

paite: "TOUPA aw, hon hehpih inla, ka hinna hihdam in, na tung ah thil ka hihkhial ngal a," ka chi a.
english: I said, “Yahweh, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

paite: "Hon doute'n, chikchiang in asi in, amin amang diam aw!" chi in hon gensia uhi.
english: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

paite: Alak ua kuahiam in ahong veh lai in, thu bangmah lou maimai agen zel a; alungtang in thulimlouhna alakhawm a; apawtkhiaktak in mi ahilh zel hi.
english: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

paite: Hon ho tengteng hon gensia in akihuau ua; hon hihsiatna ding uh angaihtuah uhi.
english: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

paite: Natna hoih loutak in amankipta, tua lum athounawn kei ding, achi ua.
english: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”

paite: Ahi, ka lawm kithuahpih theih, ka muantak, ka tanghou nekpih ngei in akhetul ka tung ah alikta hi.
english: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA aw, nang hon hehpih inla, amau ka thuktheihna ding in hon kaithou nawn in.
english: But you, Yahweh, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

paite: Hiai ah ka tung ah na kipak chih ka thei hi, hon dou in ahon zoh louh ziak in.
english: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.

paite: Kei zaw lungsim hoihtak ka putna ah nangma'n na hon len tinten a, Na ma ah tangtawn a ding in na hon koih hi.
english: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

paite: TOUPA, Israel' Pathian, tangtawn a kipan tangtawn pha in phat in om hen, Amen! Amen!
english: Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.
